meta.title: About — Mellon
meta.description: Mellon exists because brand, product, and engineering usually get designed in separate rooms — and it shows. We keep them in one room.

blocks.headline: A design studio built to run design and development as one practice.
blocks.subhead: Mellon exists because brand, product, and engineering usually get designed in separate rooms — and it shows. We keep them in one room.

sections.heading: Who we are
sections.body: Mellon is a design agency working across branding, product design, and design systems. We're a small, senior studio by design: every engagement is run by people who've done the specific kind of work you're hiring for, not handed to whoever's free.

sections.heading: What we do
sections.body: Ten core disciplines — branding, design systems, e-commerce design, end-to-end design, mobile app design, motion and interaction design, product design, SaaS design, UI/UX design, and UX audits — delivered individually or combined into a single end-to-end engagement.

sections.heading: How we work
sections.body: Every project runs through the same two practices: design and development. Design covers strategy, brand, UX, and UI. Development covers implementation, in Webflow, Framer, WordPress, or custom code — by people who were in the room for the design decisions, so nothing gets lost in a handoff.

sections.heading: Who we work with
sections.body: Sixteen industries and counting: architecture and interior design, automotive, civic tech, consumer electronics, e-commerce, education, fashion, finance, health and wellness, hospitality, legal, media and entertainment, nonprofits, real estate, restaurants, and technology and SaaS. Each industry page reflects patterns we've seen working in that space specifically, not a generic template.

sections.heading: Where we start
sections.body: With a conversation, not a proposal template. Tell us what you're building, and we'll tell you plainly whether we're the right studio for it.
